$Comment: Great Turkey Slayer: the title the achievement harvest_feast_great_turkey_slayer pays, the top of the Great Turkey's ladder in the Turkey Graveyard. It shows beside a player's name in menus and leaderboards once they pick it. It names no keys: title.harvest_feast_great_turkey_slayer.name and .flavor name and describe it, and .display, whose {0} is the name, is where it sits around the name. Enabled false hides it everywhere without taking it from anybody who earned it.
